Nadi, Fiji

The Crowne Plaza Fiji Nadi Bay Resort & Spa, an IHG Hotel, is where bamboo-lined luxury meets the tropical shores of Wailoaloa Beach and Nadi Bay. This Fijian paradise is a gateway to the azure waters of the Mamanuca Islands, and a stone's throw from the vibrant Nadi Town Market. Tropical Fiji Garden Retreat near Denarau Island & Nadi Airport

Nadi, Fiji

Bask in heavenly island luxury at this Novotel gem, set on 42 acres of tropical gardens, with every room overlooking the golf course and verdant green surrounds. Let serenity wash over you by the sparkling outdoor pool or indulge in alfresco dining with a pina colada at Talei Restaurant and Bar. For a stay that's equal parts convenient and relaxing, Tokatoka Resort by Warwick Hotels and Resorts takes the cake.
